answer: Wayne Hospital Company became a 340B covered entity starting on 10/1/2025 and did not begin purchasing 340B drugs until December of 2025. The program was implemented over a large portion of 2025. This data covers 10/1/25 to 12/31/25 during the timeframe we were a covered entity.This is guided by ODH feedback.

Wayne HealthCare became eligible to participate in the 340B Drug Pricing Program in October 2025 and began purchasing eligible medications through the program in December 2025. As a result, savings generated during this initial reporting period were limited due to the abbreviated implementation timeframe.Wayne HealthCare also maintains a strong commitment to cancer care services and prevention efforts, including access to local oncology services, cancer screening programs, patient education, and support resources that allow patients to receive care close to home. 340B savings help strengthen the organization's ability to sustain these services and improve access for patients across the region.
Because Wayne HealthCare participated in the 340B Program for only a small portion of this reporting period, the financial impact was modest. As program participation continues and savings increase in future years, Wayne HealthCare anticipates expanding its reinvestment in programs that improve access to care, enhance community health, support preventive services, and address the needs of underserved and vulnerable populations throughout the communities it serves.
